layout: Clean tax invoice with two line items at the same rate, a printed total quantity, a due date printed beside 'Net 45 days', and the discount and interest in a numbered terms list.
notes: Second demo bill, longer terms than the first: 1.5% discount within 15 days, net 45 days. The late charge is printed per YEAR (18% per annum), not per month, and the product rule is never to convert units, so lateFeePercentPerMonth is null. A founder who knows it is 1.5% a month can type it in.
